title: Import problems
summary: Why an import did not finish, was skipped, or did not place a clip.
alternateQueries: Why is my file not on the timeline?
Why can I not import a big video?

blocks.title: My imported file is not on a track
symptoms: imported with File > Import but nothing on the timeline
blocks.resolution: File > Import only adds files to the project's assets. Place one with Add Clip... on a track, or Place on Track in the Assets window. Dropping a file on the Tracker imports and places it.

blocks.title: A file was listed as not imported
symptoms: "Not imported (not audio or video this app can import)"
blocks.resolution: Only audio (wav, aif, aiff, flac, mp3, ogg) and video (mp4, mov, mkv, avi, webm, m4v) files are imported.

blocks.title: "another long action is still running"
symptoms: cannot start an import while another progress window is open
blocks.resolution: Wait for the current progress window to finish, or press its Cancel, then start the import again.

blocks.title: Large files fail to upload
symptoms: the project service is out of date and cannot take large files
blocks.resolution: Close Djehuti Station and the project service, then start Station again so it starts the current service.
blocks.cause: An older project service does not support uploading large files in pieces.
